content.claim_or_guidance: In the fully synthetic benchmark, sample utilization is 72 percent as of 2099-01-31.
content.rationale: The invented value supports a test of time-scoped factual retrieval.
content.recommended_action: Use only within the synthetic benchmark and preserve its date and sample boundary.

assumptions: The synthetic table is the complete benchmark population.
limitations: The value describes no real entity or market.
conditions_where_false: A different synthetic fixture is selected.
epistemic.falsification_test: Recalculate the rate from the generated numerator and denominator.

does_not_apply_when: Discussing any real organization or market.

content.claim_or_guidance: When a draft uses a universal quantifier, inspect whether the cited sample covers the asserted population.
content.rationale: A narrow sample cannot by itself establish a population-wide statement.
content.recommended_action: Record the denominator, search for counterexamples, and narrow the wording when coverage is incomplete.

assumptions: The quantifier is material to the argument.
limitations: Some definitions are universal by construction.
conditions_where_false: The population is fully enumerated or the statement is definitional.
epistemic.falsification_test: Show complete population coverage or a definition that makes the quantifier true by construction.

applies_when: A material claim uses an absolute or broad quantifier.
does_not_apply_when: The sentence is explicitly limited to the observed sample.

content.claim_or_guidance: A fictional sample reported a unit cost of 40 credits in 2001.
content.rationale: This invented observation tests expiry handling.
content.recommended_action: Refresh the underlying value before using it in any current comparison.

assumptions: The fictional unit definition is unchanged within the fixture.
limitations: The observation is deliberately expired and represents no real market.
conditions_where_false: The synthetic source table is regenerated.
epistemic.falsification_test: Compare the card with the generated source cell.

content.claim_or_guidance: A participant in a fictional meeting stated that a pilot reduced review time.
content.rationale: The statement tests the boundary between a reported claim and an independently verified fact.
content.recommended_action: Treat the statement as a source lead and seek an independent measurement before factual use.

assumptions: The fictional transcript records the statement accurately.
limitations: No independent measurement supports the underlying performance claim.
conditions_where_false: An independent source contradicts the claimed improvement.
epistemic.falsification_test: Obtain a defined baseline, measured outcome, and reproducible calculation.

applies_when: Using a meeting statement as a lead.
does_not_apply_when: Independent evidence already verifies the same scoped claim.
